title: approved-list
description: One level's approved programs as an Admin signs them (docs/spec/09-open-decisions.md, "Signing the approved list"). The server writes these exact bytes when an Admin saves a list; the Admin signs the bytes on their own computer with the list-signing key (Sign-ApprovedList.ps1), and the cabinet's broker checks that signature against the keys compiled into the agent before it reads anything in the document. The product field keeps a signature over this document from ever being mistaken for any other signed file.

level.description: The level the Admin set the list for. Shown to the person signing it; the cabinet does not choose between levels from it.

scopeId.description: The client, site or cabinet id; null for the fleet.

version.description: The level's version: it steps up by one on every change.

issuedAt.description: When the Admin saved the list on the server.
